transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 716 Pine Cliff Drive?

Yeah, this is me at 716 Pine Cliff Drive, just hanging out with the fam—four of us, all good, no water in the house, and we’re not stuck or anything, but we’re not got no truck or boat or seats to help out if needed.
Thanks for confirming your address and safety status. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Yeah, there’s four of us here total, and everyone’s good—no one’s stuck or can’t get to the phone, we’re all fine and accounted for.

Thanks for confirming everyone is accounted for and safe. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, everyone’s good to go—no one’s stuck or needs special help, not even a wheelchair or oxygen, and definitely no motorized chair or bedbound folks here at 716 Pine Cliff Drive.
Everyone’s good to go—no one needs special help here. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us four hanging out fine, no one needs a hand, and we’re all good to go—no need to send anything or anyone.
Thanks for the update, you’re all doing well. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and we’re all good—no free seats either, just the four of us stuck here, but we’re safe and cozy inside!
Thanks for sharing your situation. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—four of us here, no water in yet, and we’re all good, no one needs to be left alone, and we don’t have any truck or boat or seats to help with anything, but we’re fine!
Thanks for confirming everyone’s safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
